request: Specify and test a portable text normalizer as exactly four requirements, R1-R4: accept exactly the closed modes `trim` and `preserve`; in `trim`, remove leading and trailing Unicode whitespace, where whitespace means code points with the Unicode `White_Space` property; in `preserve`, return the input text unchanged; and for every unknown mode, fail with `unknown-mode` and return no text. In the test specification, deterministically enumerate every code point in the Unicode `White_Space` property and prove both removal at text boundaries and preservation of the same code points between retained non-whitespace code points. Keep normative behavior limited to those four requirements; do not add input-shape, transport, performance, storage, logging, or implementation requirements.
